newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Freight Links plans share placement.
newsitem.headline: Freight Links plans share placement.

text.p: Freight forwarder Freight Links Express Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has entered into a placement agreement with Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB).
It said OUB has agreed to subscribe or procure subscriptions for a minimum of 6.75 million and a maximum of 13.50 million new shares in the company at Singapore $0.65 each.
The private placement is conditional upon approval from the Stock Exchange of Singapore. Freight Links said the money raised from the placement will be used to repay bank borrowings.
